title: Console home: search in the top bar, a greeting with a work summary, compact builder actions and 56 px app tiles
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `1b3b5b102`, `/home` at 1280 px, light and dark, zh-CN, signed in as an admin with HotCRM installed (`packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`, `HomeRail.tsx`, `RecentApps.tsx`). The top bar has no search entry (the Studio landing has one); the hero is a 30 px greeting and the tagline "从上次离开的地方继续，或者探索新的内容。"; below it two full-width bordered cards "构建应用 / 从模板开始" take the first screen although only an admin sees them; "我的应用 2" is a row of 48 px icons where "系统设置" counts as an app; everything on the page is a bordered white card of the same weight.

## Target

Sections ① and ② of the artboard "系统首页 · 四段式" (1280 × 1040), in numbers; sections ③ and ④ are the two sibling cards.

1. Top bar, 48 px, grid `1fr auto 1fr`: left the product mark (28 px tile on `--primary`, 14 px / 600 name, the existing preview chip); centre a 420 × 32 px search field "搜索应用、记录、页面…" with a `⌘K` kbd that opens the console's command palette; right bell with its count, help, 28 px avatar.
2. Content column 1120 px centred, 28 px top padding, 28 px between sections.
3. Greeting 24 px / 600 with the name in `--primary`; under it one 13 px muted line that summarises the work section: "今天有 N 项待审批、M 项分配给你的任务" (both counts from the same sources the work section reads; the line reads "今天没有待办" when both are 0).
4. Admin actions sit at the right of the greeting as two 32 px chips: "从模板开始" outline, "构建应用" on `--primary-soft` with the primary-coloured icon. The two cover cards retire; their gate reasons (objectui#5521's visible reason) move to the chips' tooltip wrapper (objectui#12303 pattern) when disabled. A non-admin sees no chips.
5. "我的应用" heading 15 px / 600 with a count pill; at the right "浏览应用市场" (12 px link, marketplace gated as today) and "系统设置" as a muted 12 px link with the gear icon. Setup leaves the app row.
6. Tiles: 112 px wide, 56 px icon on the app's colour (14 px radius), 13 px / 500 name on one line with an ellipsis, 11 px muted "N 小时前打开" from the recent-items store; favourites first; an admin sees a trailing dashed "添加应用" tile that opens the same marketplace route.
7. No bordered card around sections ① and ②.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`, `HomeRail.tsx` (apps strip), `RecentApps.tsx`, the console top bar in `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` (search entry on `/home`), `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, tests beside each.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: the search field opens the command palette; a non-admin renders no builder chips; a disabled chip explains itself through the tooltip wrapper; Setup is not among the tiles; a tile shows the last-opened time from the store.
2. Screenshots at 1280 px, light and dark, admin and non-admin, as measurements in the PR text.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green; `pnpm check:i18n` green.

## Constraints

- Existing `data-testid`s (`home-build-app`, `home-start-template`, `home-authoring-gate-reason`, `home-marketplace-disabled-reason`) keep their names on the new elements.
- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only.
- Lands before the two sibling cards (same file); they rebase on it.

## Evidence

The artboards, as static HTML and 1280 px PNG renders, live on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `c4dfb417a`, never merged; the maintainer ruled that design files and screenshots do not enter main). Files: [Home.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/c4dfb417a/docs/design/console-home-login/Home.png?raw=true) · [Home.html](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/c4dfb417a/docs/design/console-home-login/Home.html?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 review of the console login page and home page with the maintainer, on objectui main `1b3b5b102` and HotCRM `63db83e2`. The maintainer approved the artboards in that session, verbatim: 「同意设计稿，创建任务」.</sub>
